claim.quote: we demonstrate that an unprecedented FWHM resolution of $\Delta E_\mathrm{FWHM} = \left(1.25\pm0.17\mathrm{\scriptsize{(stat)}}^{+0.05}_{-0.07}\mathrm{\scriptsize{(syst)}}\right)\,\text{eV}$ can be achieved.

key_value.note: FWHM energy resolution of the X-ray MMC (Fe-55 source).

name: Optimum filter-based analysis for the characterization of a high-resolution magnetic microcalorimeter towards the DELight experiment
notes: Component test 'towards the DELight experiment' (a sensor characterisation with an X-ray source), not a dark matter result.

summary.plain: A magnetic microcalorimeter, the kind of sensor DELight will use, resolved X-rays from an iron-55 source with a resolution of about 1.25 electronvolts, a record for this sensor type.
summary.technical: X-ray MMC characterised with a Fe-55 source; optimum-filter-based amplitude estimation gives FWHM resolution (1.25 +- 0.17 stat +0.05/-0.07 syst) eV; the analysis pipeline is a step for the proposed superfluid-helium experiment DELight.

title: Optimum filter-based analysis for the characterization of a high-resolution magnetic microcalorimeter towards the DELight experiment
why_it_matters: The abstract calls the analysis pipeline an important step for the realization of the proposed superfluid helium-based experiment DELight.
